status: PROPOSED DESIGN-ONLY: not executable tests, not approved byte vectors, no AELYXORA validator run
preconditions: Replace all deliberately synthetic public digests in the reference files with independently computed, verified identities before deriving any authoritative semantic hash
Use an exact offline locked package/core registry and a fully qualified runtime target, or record REJECT/not-verified
For each semantic edit classified different, validate/recompute dependent exported contracts, references and permissions before comparing canonical projections
Do not use these expectations as a released hash-domain decision, cryptographic golden vectors, or evidence of native conformance

outcomeMeaning.same: Both valid, fully resolved candidates have identical normalized semantic-projection bytes, despite potentially different snapshot/package evidence
outcomeMeaning.different: Both valid, fully resolved candidates have different normalized semantic-projection bytes; resulting hash difference requires a frozen accepted domain and real independent calculation
outcomeMeaning.reject: Schema/semantic/trust/dependency prerequisite rejects; no authoritative candidate semantic digest may be published
